title: What Is CMP? Why Semiconductors Are Flattened Again and Again
excerpt: CMP is a process that planarizes films and wiring on a wafer using chemical action and mechanical polishing. With photos of real equipment, we explain the roles of the pad, slurry, and pressure; how CMP relates to deposition, cleaning, and metrology; over-polishing and scratches; and the equipment and materials companies and jobs involved.
